cues.en: This video is a general word of caution that applies to the entire course.
cues.zh: 這支影片是一個適用整門課的一般提醒。

cues.en: This course in math in general involves a lot of terms and notations, which are super important when
cues.zh: 這門課，或者數學整體，都有許多術語和記號，對於，

cues.en: learning math and science and coding and marketing economics, politics, biology.
cues.zh: 學習數學、科學、程式、行銷、經濟、政治、生物學，都非常重要。

cues.en: Really, anything you do involves terms and notations.
cues.zh: 其實做任何事，都會涉及術語和記號。

cues.en: And these terms can differ across fields.
cues.zh: 不同領域的術語可能不同。

cues.en: Terms can actually differ between math and coding.
cues.zh: 數學和程式之間，術語也可能不同。

cues.en: Now these differences can cause confusion, and I want to say a few general words about this before we get to the real content starting in the next video.
cues.zh: 這些差異可能造成困惑，所以在下一支開始正式內容前，先談幾句。

cues.en: Let me start with a fundamental question.
cues.zh: 先從根本問題開始。

cues.en: What even is notation?
cues.zh: 記號到底是什麼？

cues.en: And actually we can group terminology into this too.
cues.zh: 其實術語也能一起歸在這裡。

cues.en: It comes from the word to take notes.
cues.zh: 它源自做筆記的意思。

cues.en: Notation is basically just shorthand for something that takes longer time to explain or to write down like an abbreviation.
cues.zh: 記號基本上是某件事情的簡寫，完整解釋或寫出來會花更多時間，就像縮寫。

cues.en: You know, for example, you write down USA three letters because writing United States of America just takes a lot of time.
cues.zh: 例如寫 USA 三個字母，因為完整寫 United States of America 太花時間。

cues.en: Notation is important because it is a simplified language that we all use to make communication and comprehension easier and more efficient, so better and faster.
cues.zh: 記號很重要，因為是共同使用的簡化語言，讓溝通與理解更容易、更有效率，也就是更好更快。

cues.en: Here's a quick example for math.
cues.zh: 舉個數學的小例子。

cues.en: What is this thing here?
cues.zh: 這是什麼？

cues.en: What is this symbol?
cues.zh: 這個符號是什麼？

cues.en: Well, this is the Greek lowercase letter PI.
cues.zh: 它是希臘文小寫字母 π。

cues.en: But in the context of a math course, you know that this is notation for the number pi.
cues.zh: 但在數學課的脈絡裡，你知道它表示數字圓周率 π。

cues.en: Now, why do we use this instead of writing out the entire number?
cues.zh: 為什麼用這個，而不是完整寫出，

cues.en: PI Well, for one thing, pi is irrational, meaning it never ends.
cues.zh: π？首先，它是無理數，表示小數永不終止。

cues.en: It would literally take an infinity to write out all of pi, but we can reasonably accurately approximate pi to, let's say, ten digits.
cues.zh: 完整寫出 π，真的需要無窮的時間，不過可以用例如十位數，相當精確地近似。

cues.en: So why not just write out that approximation?
cues.zh: 那為什麼不直接寫近似值？

cues.en: Well, for one thing, this is technically incorrect.
cues.zh: 首先，嚴格來說這不正確。

cues.en: This is not actually the number pi.
cues.zh: 它並不是真正的 π。

cues.en: Of course it is a close enough approximation for lots of applications, but well, anyway, this one
cues.zh: 當然，許多應用中這個近似已經足夠，但總之，這一個，

cues.en: symbol is just much easier to work with than worrying about memorizing and writing out even this approximation every time you need to use the number PI.
cues.zh: 符號，比起每次使用 π 都要記憶並寫出近似值，容易得多。

cues.en: Now, here's the thing.
cues.zh: 不過問題是。

cues.en: We all agree that this is the notation for the number pi, the irrational number pi.
cues.zh: 我們都同意，這是數字 π、無理數 π 的記號。

cues.en: But in computers we don't actually use this symbol.
cues.zh: 但電腦裡，實際上不使用這個符號。

cues.en: Instead, we use something like this in Python for example, use np pi.
cues.zh: 而是像這樣，例如 Python 使用 np.pi。

cues.en: So num pi pi.
cues.zh: 也就是 NumPy 的 pi。

cues.en: Now this is actually a numb pi function that calculates pi out to some degree of accuracy, which again
cues.zh: 這其實是 NumPy 的函數，把 π 計算到某個精確度，同樣，

cues.en: is not actually pi, but it is a close enough approximation for pretty much any application that we will need to worry about on computers.
cues.zh: 不是真正的 π，但對電腦上幾乎所有需要考慮的應用，都已足夠接近。

cues.en: So right here we already have a difference in notation between computers and math.
cues.zh: 所以這裡已經看到，電腦和數學的記號不同。

cues.en: Now okay, admittedly this difference is pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 好，坦白說，這個差異很直接。

cues.en: The difference is really small.
cues.zh: 差別很小。

cues.en: There are many notational differences between math and coding that are so obvious and so easy to translate that you don't even pay attention.
cues.zh: 數學和程式之間有很多記號差異，明顯又容易轉換，甚至不會注意。

cues.en: You don't even realize that there is a discrepancy.
cues.zh: 不會意識到兩者不一致。

cues.en: But other discrepancies are going to be much more confusing.
cues.zh: 但其他差異會更令人困惑。

cues.en: One that you will see in this section actually is the difference between a mathematical function versus a python function.
cues.zh: 本節就會看到一個例子，數學函數和 Python 函數的差別。

cues.en: Now, these two things have basically nothing whatsoever to do with each other, and yet they have exactly the same word, the same label.
cues.zh: 兩者基本上完全無關，卻使用完全相同的字、相同的名稱。

cues.en: Now, this can get confusing because you will be writing Python functions that are not math functions,
cues.zh: 這可能令人困惑，因為你會寫出不是數學函數的 Python 函數，

cues.en: and you will be implementing math functions in code that are not Python functions.
cues.zh: 也會用不是 Python 函數的程式，實作數學函數。

cues.en: Now that's just one example.
cues.zh: 這只是一個例子。

cues.en: There's going to be lots more examples throughout this course and throughout your adventures in using computers to understand and implement mathematics.
cues.zh: 課程中，以及你用電腦理解、實作數學的旅程中，還會有很多例子。

cues.en: So what to do about these terminal logical confusions?
cues.zh: 那這些術語混淆，該怎麼辦？

cues.en: Well, there isn't really much you or I or anyone can do.
cues.zh: 其實你、我或任何人，都沒有太多能做的。

cues.en: The thing is that computer science and mathematics are just different fields.
cues.zh: 電腦科學和數學就是不同領域。

cues.en: They are different branches of knowledge, and they developed kind of independently of each other, not entirely independently, but you know, it would be convenient if every branch of human inquiry
cues.zh: 是不同知識分支，也各自發展；不是完全獨立，但如果每個人類探索的分支，

cues.en: used exactly the same terminology, but well, that's that's not how it is.
cues.zh: 都使用完全相同的術語，會很方便，不過實際並非如此。

cues.en: It's also not really practical.
cues.zh: 也不太可行。

cues.en: It's not convenient.
cues.zh: 不見得方便。

cues.en: It's not really necessary either.
cues.zh: 也沒有真正必要。

cues.en: Anyway, The point is that the only thing you can do is be aware of the terminology and the differences and accept it for what it is.
cues.zh: 總之，唯一能做的，就是意識到術語和差異，接受它原來的樣子。

cues.en: I will do my best to define my terms and I hope that it's always going to be clear from context.
cues.zh: 我會盡力定義用詞，也希望從上下文總能清楚辨別。

cues.en: For example, if I'm referring to a Python function or a math function.
cues.zh: 例如我指的是 Python 函數，還是數學函數。

cues.en: So the conclusions of this video are that.
cues.zh: 所以這支影片的結論是。

cues.en: Terms and notation are basically just shorthand that we use to help us communicate ideas that math and
cues.zh: 術語與記號基本上是幫助溝通概念的簡寫，而數學與，

cues.en: computer science have different terms and different notations.
cues.zh: 電腦科學，有不同的術語和記號。

cues.en: And sometimes these can differ, sometimes they even conflict.
cues.zh: 有時不同，有時甚至衝突。

cues.en: Sometimes it's confusing.
cues.zh: 有時令人困惑。

cues.en: But this is just something that you have to accept.
cues.zh: 但這就是必須接受的事。

cues.en: And what you have to do is learn to think flexibly and understand concepts instead of getting too rigid and specific about individual words.
cues.zh: 你要學會彈性思考、理解概念，不要對個別詞語太僵化、太拘泥。
